manual_review.scope: Two predeclared 20-paper review generations; same-build four-question suites twice; one four-question confirmation after local repairs. Not a new 39-file question round.
manual_review.grading_rule: Citation existence, numeric matching, keyword completeness and source-pool coverage are not scientific entailment. Every published clause needs actually cited supplied support; source-page truth outside the supplied/cited excerpt is recorded separately, never silently added to model evidence.

claims.note: Attention replacement and quadratic attention/IO tiling are supported. Constant sequentially executed operations is on Transformer physical page 6/R22, not the actually cited abstract R2 or FlashAttention abstract R16. Available-but-uncited R22 cannot silently fill this gap; wording of sequence/sequential operations also needs precision.

Frozen base weights, trainable low-rank matrices, 4-bit frozen model and 65B/48GB are supported. Only adapting attention weights is the LoRA study restriction on physical page 5/R31, not a universal property established by its cited abstract R12. R31 was available but not cited.

InstructGPT SFT then ranked-feedback RLHF and DPO reward reparameterization/optimal-policy closed form/classification loss agree with the cited physical-page-1 abstracts. Does not claim analytic fitting of neural weights or unconditional sampling freedom.
LoRA frozen base/injected trainable matrices and QLoRA frozen 4-bit base/gradient flow to adapters match both abstracts. No universal attention-only restriction.
SFT/RLHF versus policy expression and classification-based learning is bounded to supplied original descriptions.
Different memory-cost targets, ZeRO redundancy removal versus QLoRA quantization/adapters, match abstracts. No evaluated compatibility, joint scaling or already-enabled stage-3 claim.

Quadratic standard attention and exact IO-aware HBM tiling are supported, chiefly by FlashAttention abstract; Transformer page-6 passage provides architecture context. Two IDs alone do not prove that each original directly establishes every comparison clause.

Few/one/zero-shot evaluation and future traditional fine-tuning match R27. The no-gradient-update statement is true in the following paragraph of GPT-3 physical page 5, but that paragraph was not transmitted/cited as R27. Full-page native reading confirms source truth, not faithful use of supplied evidence.

cases.note: Most requested mechanisms are present. Last comparison adds LoRA full-precision/usually-16-bit storage/computation without the cited LoRA abstract reporting that value, and ambiguously calls LoRA a frozen-adapter mechanism. Machine pass is not whole-answer acceptance. A separate QLoRA gradient-to-LoRA-adapters clause was unnecessarily held by the dual-original name detector.
No invented seed integer; absent-value native premise checked before billing. Local evidence refusal is not proof of every possible external source.

Three DPO mechanism claims supported. Comparison drops fine-tuning stage from no-LM-sampling clause; correctly held, leaves no published dual-original relation. It also needs a more direct InstructGPT pipeline citation for the reward-model/PPO relation.

Correct closed-form object and negative network-weight continuation was held because 并不表示 was unrecognized. Data preparation and experimental generation/temperature claims have DPO pages 5/9 evidence. Original published answer omitted the first requested distinction.
Single-source clause explicitly compares inheritance from LoRA but cites only QLoRA. Unlike a component-name-only mention, this is a real missing dual-original comparison; it stays held after repair.

Extra training settings are unnecessary but tied to cited source. In v1 physical page 9, Table 3 visibly prints base d_ff=1024; do not replace it from general memory or falsely blame extraction. This check does not resolve the paper's table/body consistency or verify every hyperparameter across versions.

Optimal policy, binary objective and LM sampling during fine-tuning are supported. Final comparison cites DPO page 2 plus InstructGPT page 11, whose latter text says SFT then comparison-data PPO. Reward-model-then-PPO attribution to InstructGPT needs its direct methods passage, not solely DPO's generic account of existing RLHF; do not silently add InstructGPT page 3.

Closed-form policy, gradient update and explicit data/experimental sampling are supported. The parenthetical claim that inference sampling is never removed is broader than its E1/E19 citations; E8 supports an experimental setting, not every inference procedure. Keep scoped experimental language.

Joint-source frozen-base/adaptation relation, 4-bit storage/16-bit computation distinction, allocation-based NF4 explanation, quantized constants and CPU/GPU paged optimizer actions have cited support. Original not_insufficient failed because 确保…分配 action was not recognized. Current zero-call completeness replay accepts all five; not a new successful generation.
Correctly refuses integer seed and does not confuse 100K steps with a seed.

The generated first comparison cites DPO only although it attributes a pipeline to InstructGPT. Correctly held. Three DPO parts do not complete the requested cross-paper comparison; no source is fabricated by repairs.

Two correct requested-scope clauses were held because 论文并未声称 and 这并不等同于 were missed in negative continuations. Original delivered answer lacks optimal-policy/object and fine-tuning distinction. Final zero-call replay retains four source-supported clauses; not a new actual pass.

source_page_checks.native_complete_page_read: GPT-3 physical page 5 including next no-gradient paragraph; ZeRO physical page 5 including planned stage-3 capacity and measured scaling conditions
source_page_checks.reused_original_page_evidence: Prior DPO physical pages 2/4/5/9, InstructGPT page 11, LoRA page 2, QLoRA page 4 and Transformer page 6 source-page assets remain under earlier immutable evidence roots.
important_boundaries: ZeRO future stage-3/trillion-capacity plan is not a measured implemented feature in that page.
Separate experimental constraints do not demonstrate evaluated combination or compatibility.
An unquoted next paragraph can establish local page truth but cannot retroactively become model-supplied evidence.
Two reviews have 20 originals in the source pool, not 20 independently summarized or correct published-paper analyses.

next_bounded_work: Use field-level mechanism/comparison output validation and explicit available evidence mapping rather than growing paper-specific answer templates or retrying until green.
Provide bounded, independently anchored adjacent source context when necessary; do not borrow uncited facts or insert expected answers.
Freeze the next repaired candidate before another fixed same-build small suite; preserve this entire failed stability run.

Keep BLOOM multi-page author extraction, table/formula boundaries, actual online discovery/subscriptions and release/install/material/public gates visible rather than conflating this round with their completion.
